note: List prices (pay as you go, US regions) used by the cost page, plus the assumptions behind the worked example. Estimates only: no figure here is read from a bill. Change a value here and rebuild to see its effect.

azure_stt_per_hour.what: Azure Speech, real-time speech to text, per audio hour

azure_speech_translation_per_hour.what: Azure Speech translation, per audio hour

azure_language_id_per_hour.what: Azure Speech language identification add-on, per audio hour (approximate)

azure_tts_per_million_chars.what: Azure neural text to speech, per million characters

foundry_sol_input_per_million.what: GPT-5.6-sol on Azure AI Foundry, Data Zone deployment, input tokens per million (as billed)

foundry_sol_output_per_million.what: GPT-5.6-sol on Azure AI Foundry, Data Zone deployment, output tokens per million, reasoning included (as billed)

gemini_lt_per_minute.what: Gemini Live Translate, per minute per target language (published post-preview rate)

cloud_run_l4_gpu_per_hour.what: Cloud Run, one NVIDIA L4 GPU, per running hour

cloud_run_4vcpu_per_hour.what: Cloud Run, 4 vCPU, per running hour

cloud_run_16gib_per_hour.what: Cloud Run, 16 GiB memory, per running hour

voice_chars_per_hour.what: characters of translated speech the voice reads in an hour of continuous speech (about 150 words a minute)

omni_stt_idle_tail_h.what: omni-stt scales to zero, but an instance keeps running (and billing) about 15 minutes after its last stream

omni_stt_streams_300m.what: streams one omni-stt L4 instance serves with the 300M model (about 6 with the 7B)

omni_stt_streams_7b.what: streams per instance with the 7B model

comment_minutes_per_room_hour.what: minutes of listeners' short comments translated back into English, per room-hour

foundry_from.what: Foundry cost per listener-language hour is measured there (news set, 392 sentences an hour): French, Portuguese and Spanish at reasoning none, Haitian Creole at reasoning low

gemini_voice_per_hour.what: Gemini voice for Haitian Creole (Azure has no Haitian voice), about $1 per hour of continuous speech; an estimate, not a list price

foundry_comment_requests_per_minute.what: translation requests per minute of comment speech (392 an hour)
